source_window.dataset: OS OpenMap Local technical specification — ImportantBuilding

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public OS OpenMap Local ImportantBuilding feature for Exeter with a physical building Polygon and record-bound classification/distinctiveName evidence. The selected Ordnance Survey technical-specification window confirms that ImportantBuilding is a generalised building feature whose geometry is a polygon representing the generalised important building and whose attributes include classification and distinctiveName, but this document window publishes no individual Exeter feature or polygon coordinates; therefore source-area/schema evidence was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
